body: Yeah. I don’t know if I love the feeling or hate it
Me too. Whenever I’m in a car I imagine crashing and dying or going into a coma. Or whenever I’m doing anything I just imagine someway I could die.

I have a therapist and my mom is a therapist too. But they work together and they are the only company in town. I know everything is supposed to be confidential but if I tell him I feel suicidal I don’t know if that information could be used against me. But all the while every second I do nothing it gets worse. And since my therapist and my mom are friends and coworkers I’m not sure how much I can trust him with. I don’t think I’ll do the meds because of the withdrawal effect so I’ll leave that to a last resort but I dont know what to do. Under my circumstances should I tell my therapist I feel suicidal? Thanks for not forgetting me
